item.tib: bzlas chog rin chen sgron ma'i 'phro 'du
item.coloph: ces bsam pa bzang po'i gros kyi rin chen sgron ma'i mgur ma pha ma'i drin gsob tshul 'di ni / bdag gi ma'i spun zla drom btsun tshul bstan gyi ma yum shi ba'i rkyen bskul nas / lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i dge sdongs su thos chung bsod phun ming gis dge sbyong du thun mtshams su bgyis pa'o … [7v5] ces pa 'di yang gnas 'dren las gud du phyung ba'o / bkra shis
item.note: the text that corresponds to the cover title ends at fol. 2v2. then, still on fol. 2v2, is the new title, bzlas chog rin chen sgron ma'i mgur ma drin lan gso byed. this text ends with its own colophon, on fol. 6r5. on fol. 6v1 is a new title, bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam (this is an extract from a text called gnas 'dren). the author or compiler did this work in memory of the mother of one of his relatives…
